caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) over epochs during fine-tuning of a Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis represents the WER, with a linear scale ranging from approximately 18 to 28, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The first line, represented by a solid black line with a triangle marker, begins at a value of approximately 24 at epoch 0 and decreases steadily to a value of approximately 20 at epoch 6. The second line, represented by a dashed blue line with a small circle marker, begins at a value of approximately 20 at epoch 0 and decreases to a value of approximately 19 at epoch 6. The third line, represented by a dotted purple line with a small square marker, begins at a value of approximately 22 at epoch 0 and decreases to a value of approximately 18 at epoch 6.
